scenarios.name: short-commarea-184
scenarios.why: #4049: the caller passed the first 184 of the COMMAREA's 194 bytes (EIBCALEN 184, X23): the fields from byte 184 are spaces and the RETURN carries that back. Only lengths at or past the last numeric field (PAGE-NUM, ends at 184) are stated: a shorter COMMAREA leaves a PIC 9 field as spaces, which IBM leaves undefined

scenarios.name: rows-sent-back-pf8-readnext-io-error

scenarios.name: rows-sent-back-pf7-readprev-io-error
scenarios.why: #4049: IOERR on the first READPREV of a PF7 (the skip over the record the browse starts on) with the ten rows sent back: the error flag is on and the rows are not cleared

scenarios.name: select-row-with-no-id-received
scenarios.why: #4049: a selection flag on a row whose USRID was never received (NUL, not blank): tests the width of the USR-SELECTED blank-or-low test.

scenarios.name: pf3-xctl-fails
scenarios.why: #4049: PF3 sets the target COADM01C and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN's XCTL answers PGMIDERR RESP2 3 (the program could not be loaded, IBM CICS TS XCTL conditions); the source has no RESP, so CICS abends the task and no screen or COMMAREA is returned

scenarios.name: select-update-xctl-fails

scenarios.name: select-delete-xctl-fails

scenarios.name: no-commarea-xctl-to-signon-fails

scenarios.name: pf7-first-id-nul-page-1

scenarios.name: pf7-first-id-blank-page-3
scenarios.why: #6166: a blank first id on page 3: SEC-USR-ID = LOW-VALUES and PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD browses back from the start of the file.

scenarios.name: pf7-first-id-nul-page-3
scenarios.why: #6166: eight LOW-VALUES as the first id on page 3: same arm as the blank form, through PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD.

scenarios.name: select-row-1-blank-id
scenarios.why: #6166: row 1 selected with 'U' and a blank (spaces) USRID01I: SEL-FLG is U, USR-SELECTED stays blank, nothing is transferred; row 2's id is not looked at.

scenarios.name: select-delete-row-10-blank-id
scenarios.why: #6166: row 10 selected with 'D' and a blank USRID10I: the last WHEN of the selection loop, the XCTL to COUSR03C is not taken.

scenarios.name: select-delete-row-3-nul-id

scenarios.name: blank-flag-row-1-then-select-row-2

scenarios.name: nul-flag-row-1-then-select-row-2
scenarios.why: #6166: row 1 has an id but no flag received (NUL): the WHEN is skipped and row 2's 'D' wins, XCTL to COUSR03C with ADMIN002.

scenarios.name: first-entry-endbr-ioerr

faults.why: IOERR on the ENDBR of the first page: no RESP, so CICS abends the task (AEIQ) before the first screen is sent

scenarios.why: #6166: the first-entry path reaches PROCESS-ENTER-KEY -> PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD; an abend there ends the task, so nothing may be sent after it (the port's `if (ended) return` after processEnterKey)

scenarios.name: no-commarea-xctl-fails-browse-fault-unreached

faults.why: never reached: the XCTL above abends the task first, so a port that runs on after it would take this fault

scenarios.why: #6166: as no-commarea-xctl-to-signon-fails, plus a STARTBR fault only a command issued after the dead XCTL would reach

notes: CardDemo's user list (transaction CU00, program COUSR00C): a page of ten users browsed from USRSEC (STARTBR / READNEXT, ENDBR), PF8 / PF7 page forward and back from the page's last / first id (a READNEXT / READPREV first steps over the record the browse starts on), a 'U' or 'D' beside a user XCTLs to the update / delete screen. usrsec.txt is CardDemo's ten DUSRSECJ users plus fifteen synthetic ones (USER0006-USER0020, named for computing pioneers, written for this case) so that three pages exist. A defect of the original the case shows: a search past the last id makes STARTBR NOTFND, and the ENDBR that follows (no RESP) abends with INVREQ.
